{{Top|leg}}
The '''Cularin News Service''' was a news network that operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], they reported that the [[Sentient Beings Opposing Violence]], a pacifist organization, were holding a conference with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Luxury]]''.
